categories.main_business_segments: Entegris operates in two primary business segments: Materials Solutions (MS) and Advanced Purity Solutions (APS). The MS segment provides materials-based solutions such as deposition materials, CMP slurries and pads, specialty gases, formulated etch and clean materials, and other specialty materials for semiconductor manufacturing. The APS segment offers filtration, purification, and contamination-control solutions to ensure the purity of critical chemistries, gases, and substrates used in semiconductor and other high-technology manufacturing processes.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: Core technologies include advanced materials science, chemical formulation and purification, high-purity filtration, specialty coatings, and precision-engineered packaging and delivery systems. Manufacturing methods involve cleanroom production, advanced membrane modification, chemical synthesis and blending, engineered polymer processing, and automated quality control systems. The company leverages proprietary technologies such as Safe Delivery Source (SDS) gas cylinders, advanced CMP slurries and pads, and sub-5nm filtration products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Entegris primarily serves logic and memory semiconductor device manufacturers, semiconductor equipment makers, gas and chemical companies, and wafer growers. Additional customers include OSAT facilities, flat panel display manufacturers, hard disk drive component makers, and companies in adjacent high-tech markets such as life sciences, clean energy, batteries, LEDs, and aerospace.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with 79% of 2024 net sales from international markets. Key regions include North America, Taiwan, China, South Korea, Japan, Europe, and Southeast Asia. Major manufacturing and R&D facilities are located in the U.S., Taiwan, South Korea, Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Canada, and China.
categories.supply_chain_position: Entegris operates primarily as a midstream and downstream supplier within the semiconductor ecosystem. It provides critical materials, consumables, and process solutions that are integrated into customers' manufacturing processes, as well as contamination control and purity solutions that support both upstream chemical suppliers and downstream device fabrication.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing technology leadership in materials purity and process solutions, expanding R&D for next-generation semiconductor nodes, and developing co-optimized, integrated solutions across the manufacturing process. The company invests heavily in ER&D (9.8% of 2024 net sales), collaborates closely with customers on technology roadmaps, and pursues innovation in advanced materials, filtration, and contamination control. Expansion into adjacent markets and ongoing operational excellence are also key focuses.
categories.revenue_model: Entegris generates revenue primarily through the sale of consumable products and materials that are repeatedly used in semiconductor manufacturing, resulting in a largely recurring and unit-driven revenue base. Additional revenue streams include sales of equipment, licensing of intellectual property, and technical support services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Key competitors in the APS segment include Pall Corporation (Danaher), Shin-Etsu Polymer, Cobetter Filtration, Gudeng Precision, and Aicello. In the MS segment, competitors include EMD Performance Materials (Merck KGaA), DuPont Electronics & Industrial, Air Liquide Electronics Advanced Materials, Linde, Anji Microelectronics, and Mersen. Entegris differentiates itself with the industry's broadest portfolio in materials purity and process solutions, and claims no single global competitor matches its full range of offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, Entegris reported net sales of $3.24 billion, with a gross margin of 45.9% and net income of $292.8 million. The company has a global workforce of approximately 8,200 employees and a market capitalization of $18.3 billion as of June 2024. While 2024 sales declined 8% year-over-year due to divestitures, the company maintains a strong growth profile driven by secular semiconductor demand and ongoing investments in capacity and innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Entegris emphasizes its ability to deliver the highest levels of materials purity and contamination control, which are critical for advanced semiconductor manufacturing yields and device performance. Its broad, integrated portfolio, deep customer collaboration, and co-optimized solutions reduce customer risk, accelerate time to yield, and lower total cost of ownership. The company’s recurring revenue model, global infrastructure, and technology leadership further differentiate it from competitors.
